title: Finite checking alphabet
statement: For a type $S$ and a natural number $k$, the type of checks has constructors for an initial state and output-register value; an initial tape symbol with two Boolean annotations; an initial index with two Boolean annotations; a zero-negation check carrying an optional tape position and a Boolean; a state transition carrying old and new state/output-register data and the scanned-symbol and tape-update data; a tape-cell transition check carrying that same transition data together with a position and Boolean; an index transition check carrying that transition data and a Boolean; a boundary check carrying the transition data; and a final check.
